description: Turn a quoteId from get_quote into the UNSIGNED transaction the user's own wallet must sign: EVM {chainId, to, data, value in wei, optional ERC-20 approval to send first} or Solana {serializedTx base64}. Includes plain-language signing steps. The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions. Only use this when the user has their own signer and explicitly wants raw transaction data, after they confirmed the quote; otherwise give them the swap link.

quoteId.description: quoteId from get_quote (starts with "q_"). Quotes expire after a short time (see expiresAt).

name: build_transaction
title: Build the unsigned transaction for a quote
